editorial_note: Single-message League, gamer and dry humor. No claims of viral ranking or creator originality. Social video research was access-limited; selected lines do not depend on audio or video. The final 20 are familiar circulating dad jokes.

research_sources.use: Community banter reference; not copied wholesale.
Pun reference; overly context-dependent entries excluded.
Broad humor/community context, not evidence these jokes are viral.
